ref=$("$HORIZON_GIT" symbolic-ref HEAD)
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5
do

  parent=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" read-tree "$parent"
  cd "$HORIZON_LEDGER_WORK_TREE"
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" apply --cached --whitespace=error - <<'"'PATCH'
diff --git a/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian.lean b/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian.lean
--- a/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian.lean
+++ b/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian.lean
@@ -649,6 +649,7 @@ import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffStalkEval
 import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffFibreData
 import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffFibreRank
 import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffThetaRestriction
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffThetaDescent
 -- The field-level window-recovery mono is CARRIER-FREE (run 0089 r6, ajcr-p3): the rung
 -- I-1248 named as the widened tower's load-bearing missing piece reads its carrier only
 -- through "'`eqns`, so the widened analogue needs no widened mathematics. Rooted so the
PATCH
  tree=$(GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" write-tree)
  commit=$(printf '"'%s\\n\\n%s\\n%s\\n%s\\n%s\\n%s\\n%s\\n' \\
    'chore(pic): root intrinsic theta descent' \\
    'Archon-Run: 0094' \\
    'Archon-Round: 3' \\
    'Archon-Role: horizon' \\
    'Archon-Session: 0008-horizon-pic-d' \\
    'Archon-Task: pic-d' \\
    'Archon-Projects: Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild' \\
    'Archon-Commit: checkpoint' | \""'$HORIZON_GIT" commit-tree "$tree" -p "$parent")
  rm -f "$idx"
  if "$HORIZON_GIT" update-ref "$ref" "$commit" "$parent"
  then
    printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$commit"
    exit 0
  fi
  cd /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild
done
exit 1'

    10	
    11	The **assembly step** of the right exactness of the section sequence
    12	(`informal/dat-d-worksheet.md` §2.3 step 2): the Θ-twisted colength evaluation
    13	`thetaGluedEval : H⁰(𝒪(Θᵃ)) → W(d)^{Θᵃ}` of `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyTheta`
    14	is surjective, GIVEN the two cohomological inputs in section-level form:
    15	
    16	* **chart lifting** (`DivisorAdaptation.LiftsOnChart₀/₁`): every Θ-twisted glued colength
    17	  family lifts, on each pinned chart separately, to a chart section reducing to it on
    18	  every piece — the vanishing of `H¹` of the twisted ideal sheaf `𝒪(Θᵃ − d)` on the
    19	  affine pinned chart (Serre, quasi-coherent Čech on the basic-open pieces);
    20	* **overlap correction** (`relThetaOverlapCorrection`): every section of the chart
    21	  overlap all of whose germs lie in the stalk ideals of `d` splits as a Θ-twisted
    22	  difference of chart sections vanishing along `d` — the two-chart Čech
    23	  `H¹(𝒪(Θᵃ − d)) = 0` (relative; fired by the engine at fibre degree
    24	  `a·δ − deg d ≥ b`, DAT-0a).

    26	Given these, the preimage of a glued family `w` is assembled as follows: lift `w` on
    27	each chart (`σ₀`, `σ₁`), observe that the mismatch `τ = σ₀ − θᵃ·σ₁` on the chart overlap
    28	vanishes along `d` germwise (the Θ-twisted matching of `w` on the piece overlaps),

    31	disappears in every colength because a section vanishing along `d` germwise lies in the

    35	The discharge of the two inputs from the glued-sheaf datum of `𝒪(Θᵃ − d)` and the rigid

   196	
   197	end Scheme.QcohOn
   198	
   199	section StructureSheaf
   200	
   201	/-! ### The structure sheaf satisfies the packaging
   202	
   203	`Scheme.moduleKSheaf k` carries the tautological action `qsmul h r s = X.resHom h r * s`
   204	of ambient sections, natural under restriction since restriction is a ring homomorphism;
   205	the localization axioms are the landed affine-open localization lemmas of
   206	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.AffineCech`. This instance recovers the landed
   207	structure-sheaf vanishing (`IsAffineOpen.subsingleton_moduleKSheaf_hModule'_one`) as a
   208	special case of the generalized engine. -/
   209	
   210	variable [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
   211	
   212	/-- Reinterpret a section of `X.moduleKSheaf k` over `W` as a scheme section in
   213	`Γ(X, W)`. The two types are definitionally equal; this identity bridge pins the
   214	`Γ`-spelling so that ring operations elaborate without coercion noise. -/
   215	private def moduleKSheafToΓ {W : X.Opens} (s : (X.moduleKSheaf k).obj.obj (op W)) :
   216	    Γ(X, W) := s
   217	
   218	/-- The structure sheaf as a sheaf of `k`-modules is quasi-coherently packaged on every
   219	open `U`: ambient sections act by restriction-then-multiplication, and the localization
   220	axioms are `IsAffineOpen.exists_res_eq_pow_mul` and
   221	`IsAffineOpen.exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_eq_zero`. -/
   222	noncomputable instance Scheme.moduleKSheaf.instQcohOn (U : X.Opens) :
   223	    Scheme.QcohOn (X.moduleKSheaf k) U where
   224	  qsmul {W} hWU r s := X.resHom hWU r * moduleKSheafToΓ s
   225	  one_qsmul {W} hWU m := by
   226	    change X.resHom hWU 1 * moduleKSheafToΓ m = moduleKSheafToΓ m
   227	    rw [map_one, one_mul]
   228	  mul_qsmul {W} hWU r s m := by
   229	    change X.resHom hWU (r * s) * moduleKSheafToΓ m =
   230	      X.resHom hWU r * (X.resHom hWU s * moduleKSheafToΓ m)
   231	    rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]
   232	  add_qsmul {W} hWU r s m := by
   233	    change X.resHom hWU (r + s) * moduleKSheafToΓ m =
   234	      X.resHom hWU r * moduleKSheafToΓ m + X.resHom hWU s * moduleKSheafToΓ m
   235	    rw [map_add, add_mul]
   236	  qsmul_add {W} hWU r m n :=
   237	    mul_add (X.resHom hWU r) (moduleKSheafToΓ m) (moduleKSheafToΓ n)
   238	  secRes_qsmul {V W} hVW hWU r m := by
   239	    change X.resHom hVW (X.resHom hWU r * moduleKSheafToΓ m) =
   240	      X.resHom (hVW.trans hWU) r * X.resHom hVW (moduleKSheafToΓ m)
   241	    rw [map_mul, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   242	  exists_secRes_eq_qsmul_pow {V} hV hVU g c := by
   243	    obtain ⟨N, e, he⟩ := hV.exists_res_eq_pow_mul hVU g (moduleKSheafToΓ c)
   244	    refine ⟨N, e, ?_⟩
   245	    change X.resHom inf_le_left e =
   246	      X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hVU) (g ^ N) * moduleKSheafToΓ c
   247	    rw [map_pow]
   248	    exact he
   249	  exists_qsmul_pow_eq_zero {V} hV hVU g t ht := by
   250	    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hV.exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_eq_zero hVU g
   251	      (moduleKSheafToΓ t) ht
   252	    refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
   253	    change X.resHom hVU (g ^ M) * moduleKSheafToΓ t = 0
   254	    rw [map_pow]
   255	    exact hM
   256	
   257	/-- On the structure sheaf, the packaged action is restriction-then-multiplication. -/
   258	lemma Scheme.moduleKSheaf_qsmul_eq {U W : X.Opens} (hWU : W ≤ U) (r : Γ(X, U))
   259	    (s : Γ(X, W)) :
   260	    Scheme.QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.moduleKSheaf k) hWU r s = X.resHom hWU r * s := rfl
   261	
   262	end StructureSheaf
